component.name: Office 365 Suite (Community Client)
component.summary: Office web apps desktop client with native OneDrive synchronization

description.p: An open-source community desktop client for cloud Office web applications featuring native background file synchronization powered by the abraunegg/onedrive daemon, tray controls, and desktop notifications.

screenshot.caption: Office 365 Suite dashboard with integrated web apps and OneDrive sync status

description.p: Rebranded to Office 365 Suite (Community Client), upgraded to GNOME Platform 50 runtime, added Graph API support, and unified single sign-on.
Major update featuring native OneDrive sync toggle, dynamic sidebar controls, localized desktop integration, and UI refinements.
First stable release featuring OneDrive daemon sync, tray menu, and Fluent Design UI.
